description: Editing, deleting and excluding a speech clip.

preconditions: An existing sentence in the record; the actor is the meeting's Chair (active user).
cases.inputs: clipId; actorId: the Chair; excluded true; reason 'Leak'.
cases.return: Success (200, MSG351) with true; ExcludedAt, ExcludedBy and reason Leak are set.
cases.log: Audit SpeechClipExcluded (sentence, meeting, speaker, reason); a ClipEdited change is published.

preconditions: An excluded sentence; the actor is the meeting's Secretary.
cases.inputs: clipId; actorId: the Secretary; excluded false (reason ignored).
cases.return: Success (200, MSG352) with false; ExcludedAt, ExcludedBy and reason are cleared.
cases.log: Audit SpeechClipRestored; a ClipEdited change is published.

preconditions: An existing sentence; the actor is an active Member (neither Chair nor Secretary).
cases.inputs: clipId; actorId: the Member; excluded true; reason 'Other'.

preconditions: An existing sentence; the actor is the meeting's Chair.
cases.inputs: clipId; actorId: the Chair; excluded true; reason 'Noise'.
cases.return: Invalid (400, MSG354) with an error on reason: “Lý do phải là Leak hoặc Other.”.

cases.inputs: clipId: a random id; actorId: the Chair; excluded true; reason 'Leak'.

preconditions: An existing sentence; the actor is the meeting's Chair.
cases.inputs: clipId; actorId: the Chair; excluded true; reason 'Other'.
cases.log: Error log 'Failed to change the exclusion of speech clip'.
